_note: Written before any run of the system (C2.3). Images come from tools/make_assets.py. 'checks' are the machine-checkable form of each rubric; 'target_text' is an independent description of the intended result used only for evaluation (never shown to the agents).

scenarios.rubric: PASS if routed to caption/question (no image generated), the caption mentions a cat, and at least 2 visual Q&A answers are returned.

scenarios.request: How many cats are in this picture?
scenarios.rubric: PASS if no image is generated and the answer says there are two cats.

scenarios.request: What route number or destination is written on the front of the bus?
scenarios.rubric: PASS if no image is generated and the answer (or the extracted visible text) contains the route number 15 or the destination Aldwych.

scenarios.request: Turn this photo into a watercolor painting.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if an image is generated by img2img (no LoRA), it is safe, it looks like a watercolor painting of cats (CLIP to target >= 0.25) and keeps the original layout (CLIP image similarity to input >= 0.55).

checks.target_text: a watercolor painting of two cats lying on a pink couch

scenarios.request: Make this sketch look like a realistic photograph of mountains and a river.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if an image is generated by img2img, it is safe, it looks like a photo of mountains (CLIP to target >= 0.25) and keeps the sketch layout (similarity >= 0.55).

checks.target_text: a realistic photograph of mountains and a river valley

scenarios.request: Render this room in the style of a Van Gogh oil painting.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if an image is generated by img2img, it is safe, it looks like a Van Gogh style painting of a room (CLIP to target >= 0.25) and keeps the room layout (similarity >= 0.55).

checks.target_text: a van gogh style oil painting of a living room

scenarios.rubric: PASS if InstructPix2Pix is used, the output is safe, shows tigers (CLIP to target >= 0.24) and keeps the scene (similarity >= 0.55).

checks.target_text: two tigers lying on a pink couch

scenarios.request: Make it a snowy winter scene.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if InstructPix2Pix is used, the output is safe, shows snow (CLIP to target >= 0.24) and the bear is preserved (similarity >= 0.55).

checks.target_text: a brown bear in the snow in winter

scenarios.request: Enhance this photo: brighten it and make it sharper.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if routed to enhancement (low-strength img2img), the output is safe, still clearly the same bedroom (similarity >= 0.75) and matches a bright bedroom photo (CLIP to target >= 0.24).

checks.target_text: a bright, sharp photo of a bedroom with a bed and a bookshelf

scenarios.request: Draw these two cats in Naruto anime style.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the Part 2 Naruto LoRA is used (domain img2img), the output is safe and looks like an anime drawing of cats (CLIP to target >= 0.25).

checks.target_text: an anime drawing of two cats

scenarios.request: Turn this landscape into a Naruto-style ninja village scene.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the Part 2 LoRA is used (domain img2img), the output is safe and looks like an anime landscape (CLIP to target >= 0.25).

checks.target_text: an anime illustration of a village landscape with mountains

scenarios.request: Generate a Naruto-style ninja with a red scarf standing on a cliff at sunset.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the Part 2 LoRA is used for text-to-image (no input image), the output is safe and shows an anime ninja on a cliff (CLIP to target >= 0.25).

checks.target_text: an anime illustration of a ninja with a red scarf on a cliff at sunset

scenarios.rubric: PASS if the system asks for clarification (no generation, no crash) and suggests concrete options.
PASS if the broken file is reported with a clear message (status error, no internal exception, no image).

scenarios.request: Turn this into an oil painting.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the blank, poor-quality image is reported with a clear message (no generation, no crash).
